meta.title: I Sold My Clothes and Became a Minimalist.
meta.description:
Hello dear viewer today I talk about minimalism and my poor attempt at it. Taylor says I should say "pseudo-minimalism" which I think is her nice way of saying you are a failure.

HAVE YOU EVER CONSIDERED SUBSCRIBING/FOLLOWING ME ON IG? @8thWeekday

Want to support the channel? Check out the links DOWN BELOW!

Minimalism! There's a whole Netflix documentary about it (directed by the YouTuber Matt D'Avela!). I can't pull off the pure minimalist vibe or look BUT I'm making a bit of an effort to try and slim down my clothes and keep my worldly possessions to a minimal. Maybe I'll even buy one of those minimalist nativity scenes for Christmas this year!

MY FAVE PRODUCTS (affiliate links - help support the channel!):

#theironsnail

The Iron Snail is a men’s fashion vlog starring a young man named Michael and featuring a snail no bigger than a quarter. The two are set on taking over the world of fashion by creating a clothing line to end all clothing lines. Until then, we’re here to tell you EVERYTHING you need to know about the best clothing out there, from the highest quality raw denim jeans to the warmest jacket to the sturdiest boots…the Iron Snail has got you covered. (written by Taylor, though Michael is sometimes known to talk about himself in the third person… xoxo)
